High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Misc .
Criminal Case No. 37476 of 2025

Mithun
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Vikram Bhatnagar - Advocate for the applicant.

Shri Vishal Singh Panwar -Ga appearing on behalf of Ad
 General[r-1].
 Order
1] They are heard and perused the case diary.

2] This is the applicant's third bail application filed under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023/ Section 439 of Cr.P.C. as he is implicated in connection with Crime No.49/2024 registered at Police Station Dwarkapuri Indore Dist. Indore (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 365, 376(D), 323, 506 of IPC.

entities.text: Police Station Dwarkapuri Indore Dist. Indore
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The applicant is in custody since 25/1/2024.
His second bail application was dismissed as withdrawn by the coordinate bench of this Court vide order dated 3.4.2025 passed in MCRC.No.9849/2025.

3] Allegations against the applicant is of gang rape of the prosecutrix, who according to the case of the prosecution, was abducted by the accused persons from 8.9.2023 to 15.9.2023 whereas the FIR has been lodged on 25.1.2024.

4] Counsel has submitted that that co-accused person namely Deepak, Rohit and Vishal have already been granted bail by this Court in M.Cr.C. No.26935.2025, 23739/2025 and 29255/2025 vide order dated 5.8.2025, and the case of the applicant is identical to that of aforesaid co-accused NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:25087 2 MCRC-37476-2025 persons.
Thus, it is prayed that the application be allowed.
5] Counsel for the State has opposed the prayer.

6] On due Mithun vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25242908/
1

entities.text: Mithun vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: consideration
of submissions
and on perusal of the case-diary as also the order passed in the case of co-accused Deepak, Rohit and Vishal, this Court is inclined to allow the present application.

7]
Accordingly, maintaining parity, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application filed by the applicant is hereby allowed.

The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his/her regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he / she shall remain present before the court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
8] Accordingly, the application is allowed and disposed of.
C.c. as per rules.

(SUBODH ABHYANKAR) JUDGE das Mithun vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25242908/
